The 640 derivatives and 320-width display lose fine lines and skin detail, particularly in testimony; no exact apparent numeric age or preservation of every wrinkle is certified.

These images enrich their reading sections with coherent warm light and restrained colors against the dark teal/gold page design rather than repeating one interchangeable pose. No conspicuous normal-display block seam, halo or color-break artifact was observed.

Current artwork views preserve the main head, hands, horse and environmental framing without a new responsive crop; hospitality retains the threshold and visible shoe. The desktop ride capture ends about 0.36 CSS pixels before the reported artwork bottom, a viewport-boundary limitation rather than proof of a full-frame screenshot. checks.characters_realism: The visible selected character, fabric, hair, light and contact relationships remain coherent at normal size. Enlarged inspection reveals expected progressive smoothing and pixel quantization in smaller WebPs, not recovered detail. Hidden body surfaces, far fingers, saddle/pelvis, exact hair topology and documentary physical dimensions are not certified; this is illustrative photorealistic artwork, not a photograph of the historical events.
checks.period_sources: The exact five public-safe provenance summaries were read and verified against the retained historical receipt bytes and authored time fields, including selected-source matches and the earlier actual derivative review. Modest dresses, pinned hair, small closed book, wood/plaster interiors and doorway are visibly consistent with the reviewed period-oriented illustrative design, with no conspicuous modern prop introduced by the derivatives. This does not authenticate a particular garment, building, book copy or event reconstruction. Historical source-art reviews are not retroactive canonical preflight and are not assembled-page approval; generation timestamps remain unknown.
checks.anatomy: Visible poses and hand contacts remain coherent within the selected artwork. The ride has three clearly readable complete hooves; the far hind hoof is naturally occluded by debris/limb overlap. Strict four-complete-hooves-visible status remains NOT_MET_OCCLUDED. Natural occlusion is accepted only within the exact owner-selected v17 scope and does not prove unseen anatomy or erase that failed visibility criterion.
checks.uniqueness: The final selected ride is v17 and the four other scenes are corrective v2. Their distinct hair silhouettes, dress colors, pose, gaze and environments remain intact across all fifteen derivatives and current assembled views. No generation, replacement, source edit or revival of a rejected ride variant was performed. Proportional re-encoding is not byte/pixel identity with the PNG or a lossless claim.
checks.desktop_phone: Personally inspected all forty-five current V7.1 captures at native display: fifteen normal headers, fifteen artwork viewports, three hub views, three focused skip-link states, two mobile menus, two mobile search dialogs and five 390-width artwork dialogs. At 1280/390/320 the corrected headers are styled, legible and separated from content; the old raw-link-header defect is absent. Search/menu controls are distinct; title/button wrapping and text gutters are readable. The focused skip link is conspicuous above the header, not an unfocused body obstruction. Search dialogs fit both phone widths with legible field, action and Close. Lower menu content and longer art dialogs can extend beyond their initial visible panel; hymnal bottom Close is partly below the initial view and testimony bottom Close is below it, while the top-right close control is visible. This is browser-width evidence, not a physical-phone, touch-keyboard, all-browser or exhaustive accessibility certification.
